statement: US forces conduct at least one strike on a target located on Iranian land territory, including Iranian islands, between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if US Central Command, the Pentagon or the White House officially confirms a US strike on Iranian land territory or islands occurring between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15. Strikes only on vessels at sea do not count.
failure_condition: The United States carries out no strike on Iranian land territory or islands at any time between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.

statement: At least one Houthi-launched ballistic missile or drone is intercepted over, or strikes, Saudi Arabian territory between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: TRUE if the Saudi-led coalition spokesman, the Saudi Ministry of Defense or the Saudi Press Agency states that a Houthi missile or drone was intercepted over or struck Saudi territory between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-15.
failure_condition: No Houthi-launched missile or drone is intercepted over or impacts Saudi Arabian territory between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-15.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its 2026-12-08 to 2026-12-09 meeting, with the decision announced on 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement issued 2026-12-09 raises the target range, as shown by FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 exceeding its 2026-12-08 value. Unchanged or lower resolves FALSE.
failure_condition: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged or lowers it at the meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.

statement: The ICE Brent front-month crude futures contract settles below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-12-15. Reference: 111.70 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Futures Europe official settlement price of the front-month Brent crude futures contract on 2026-12-15 is below 100.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 111.70 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The front-month ICE Brent settlement price on 2026-12-15 is at or above 100.00 USD per barrel.

statement: Likud wins more Knesset seats than any other list in the Israeli general election held on 2026-10-27.
resolution: TRUE if the final official results of the 2026-10-27 Knesset election published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee give Likud strictly more seats than every other list. A tie resolves FALSE.
failure_condition: Another list wins as many Knesset seats as Likud, or more, in the 2026-10-27 election.

statement: Democrats win at least 218 of 435 seats in the US House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if the Clerk of the House party breakdown for the 120th Congress, after members elected on 2026-11-03 are sworn in, lists at least 218 Democrats. Fewer than 218 resolves FALSE.
failure_condition: Democrats hold fewer than 218 House seats when the members elected on 2026-11-03 are sworn into the 120th Congress.

statement: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva defeats Flavio Bolsonaro in the Brazilian presidential runoff held on 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) official totals for the 2026-10-25 presidential runoff give Lula da Silva more than 50 percent of valid votes; FALSE if Flavio Bolsonaro wins.
failure_condition: Flavio Bolsonaro receives more than 50 percent of valid votes in the 2026-10-25 runoff.

statement: The French National Assembly adopts a motion of censure against the government between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Assemblee nationale official vote record shows a motion de censure adopted by an absolute majority of deputies on a date between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No motion of censure reaches an absolute majority of deputies in the National Assembly between 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Nigeria confirms at least one new Ebola case between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20, raising its cumulative confirmed count above the total held on 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if an NCDC situation report or WHO Disease Outbreak News shows Nigeria with a higher cumulative confirmed Ebola case count for a date between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20 than on 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No additional person in Nigeria is laboratory-confirmed with Ebola between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20.

statement: The UK Met Office, Met Eireann or KNMI names at least one new storm, following Storm Boelo, between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the Met Office storm names page records a storm named by the UK, Ireland and Netherlands group with a naming date between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: The UK, Ireland and Netherlands naming group names no new storm between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
